tool.name: Savont SINTAX
tool.description: Genus-level classification of ASVs with k-mer bootstrapping (SINTAX algorithm)
tool.command: mkdir -p 'staging_in' && ln -s '$asv_fasta' 'staging_in/final_asvs.fasta' && #if $feature_table ln -s '$feature_table' 'staging_in/feature-table.tsv' && #end if savont sintax -i 'staging_in' -d '$db.fields.path' -o 'staging_out' -t "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" --min-bootstrap $bootstrap.min_bootstrap --n-iter $bootstrap.n_iter $bootstrap.detailed_unclassified && cp staging_out/savont_*.log '$output_log'

param.name: asv_fasta
param.label: ASV sequences
param.help: Representative ASV sequences (``final_asvs.fasta``) as produced by **Savont ASV**.

param.name: feature_table
param.label: Feature table
param.help: Optional feature table (``feature-table.tsv`` from **Savont ASV**). It is required for runs of several pooled samples to obtain per-sample abundances; for a single sample the ASV depths are read from the sequence headers instead.

param.name: min_bootstrap
param.label: Minimum bootstrap confidence
param.help: Minimum bootstrap confidence required for genus and all higher taxonomic ranks.

param.name: n_iter
param.label: Number of bootstrap iterations
param.help: Number of bootstrap iterations used by the SINTAX algorithm.

param.name: detailed_unclassified
param.label: Report detailed unclassified ASVs
param.help: Report unassigned ranks as UNCLASSIFIED-<asv_header> instead of plain UNCLASSIFIED.

tool.help:
**Savont SINTAX** classifies the representative ASV sequences produced by **Savont ASV** at genus level against a Savont reference database, using the SINTAX k-mer bootstrapping algorithm.
SINTAX does not require a full alignment: it compares k-mers of each ASV with the k-mer counts of the reference database and bootstraps the classification to estimate a confidence for every taxonomic rank. Ranks below the minimum bootstrap confidence (0.8 by default) are reported as unclassified.
Inputs ------
* **ASV sequences**: the ``final_asvs.fasta`` output of **Savont ASV**. * **Feature table** *(optional)*: the ``feature-table.tsv`` output of **Savont ASV**. It is the authoritative source of the per-sample ASV abundances and must be supplied for runs that pooled several samples. * **Savont reference database**: a database installed with the *Savont reference databases* data manager.
Outputs -------
* **Genus abundance table**: relative abundance per taxonomic level, one row per genus. * **ASV mappings**: the genus-level taxonomic assignment of every ASV.
**SINTAX** is faster than **Savont classify** and works better for higher taxonomic assignments when the microbiome is not well captured by the reference database.
